empirical_summary.scope: All retained pilot and expansion per_run entries; state evidence, trusted tool-event evidence and release-event contexts. Expansion initial/final contexts are also compared. No provider narrative, deterministic reference, failed preflight or new scripted case is treated as empirical data.
empirical_summary.counting: Evidence records are deduplicated by canonical JSON digest within phase; location lists preserve all inspected repetitions. Counts are records/contexts, not independent observations.
empirical_summary.pilot_comparison_limit: Expansion controls do not accept pilot schema. Pilot labels are checked against pilot checker names; analogous evidence filtering is evaluated with the original pilot gate. This is not deployment of the expansion variant.
